This market will resolve to "Yes" if the named running back finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) ranked among the top 5 running backs by total fantasy points under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, that market will resolve to "No".

Only regular-season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. If two or more running backs are tied such that more than 5 would qualify for the top 5, the tie will be broken by higher fantasy points per game average for the 2026 NFL regular season, and if a tie still persists, by last name in alphabetical order, so that exactly 5 running backs are classified as top 5.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the rankings cannot be determined within this timeframe, all markets in this event will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Kyle Pitts Sr.'s average fantasy points per game during the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) equals or exceeds 11.0 under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Average fantasy points per game is the player's total PPR fantasy points for the 2026-27 NFL regular season divided by the number of regular season games in which the player appeared, as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports. Only regular season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. There is no minimum number of games played. If the listed player does not appear in any 2026-27 NFL regular season game, this market will resolve to "No".

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the per-game averages cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

title: Pro Football: 2026-27 Worst Regular Season Record
description:
This market will resolve according to the team that finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the worst regular season record (the lowest winning percentage among all 32 teams).

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to finish the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the worst regular season record, the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If two or more teams finish tied for the worst regular season record, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team that is assigned the earliest selection position in the 2027 NFL Draft under the NFL's draft order tie-breaking procedures (strength of schedule, then the applicable divisional or conference tiebreakers), before accounting for any traded or forfeited selections.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed after January 24, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the final regular season standings have not been officially determined within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

This market will resolve according to the team that finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the worst regular season record (the lowest winning percentage among all 32 teams).

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to finish the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the worst regular season record, the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If two or more teams finish tied for the worst regular season record, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team that is assigned the earliest selection position in the 2027 NFL Draft under the NFL's draft order tie-breaking procedures (strength of schedule, then the applicable divisional or conference tiebreakers), before accounting for any traded or forfeited selections.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed after January 24, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the final regular season standings have not been officially determined within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Pro Football: 2026-27 Last Unbeaten Team
description:
This market will resolve according to the team that remains without a single loss the longest during the 2026-27 NFL regular season.

Ties do not count as losses.

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to be the last team remaining without a loss, the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If multiple teams suffer their first loss on the same day, or if multiple teams finish the 2026-27 NFL regular season without a loss, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team that played the most games before recording its first loss, regardless of the number of ties recorded by those teams.

If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team with the greater strength of victory in all games, and then the tied team with the greater strength of schedule in all games, as those terms are used in the NFL's official tie-breaking procedures (https://www.nfl.com/standings/tie-breaking-procedures). If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team whose full team name, as listed in this market, comes first alphabetically. The "Other" option will not be considered in these tie-breaks.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed after January 24, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the team that remained without a loss the longest cannot be determined within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

title: What will the announcers say during the Seahawks vs Broncos game?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official Prime Video announce team during the English-language broadcast of the Seattle Seahawks vs Denver Broncos game on Prime Video, scheduled for October 15, 2026 at 8:15 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "Prime Video announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

The resolution source for this market is the national Prime Video telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

For full rules, see: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/market_products/Mentions/Event+Mentions+Contract+DeFi.pdf

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the fourth quarter is the quarter in which the most total points are scored by both teams combined. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". Only points scored in the four regulation quarters count; overtime is not included. If two or more quarters tie for the most points scored, or if no points are scored in the game, the "Other" outcome resolves "Yes". All outcomes are based on the official NFL game book as published on NFL.com. Exactly one outcome in the group resolves "Yes". If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, the "Other" outcome resolves "Yes".
